column55: Doors, door assemblies and hardware must be maintained in good condition. Locks at all entrances to dwelling units must tightly secure the door.
Windows must be kept in good condition and weather tight.
Doors and door frames must be kept in good condition and weather tight.
Stairways, steps, and their attachments must structurally sound, in good repair, with proper anchorage and able to support imposed loads.
All structures and exterior property must be kept free from rodent harborage and infestation. When found, rodents must be promptly exterminated by approved processes.
Unoccupied structures must be boarded and secured to prevent entry of unauthorized persons.
